notes.title: LION The Last Homeland Update 0.5.4
notes.content: [p]Great day to all and I hope you all had a great summer, after a lot of work I com where with a new update for LION’s Early access, now I have been spending most of the time creating the final content of the Golden version of the game, which I will be showcasing in the following months, as for the content available in the Early access it comes mostly as bug fixes and Performance improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]The Radial Menu[/p][p]The radial menu has several changes, first it will now complete stop to time allowing the player to take a breath and do tactics with the children, allowing now to cast an ability and set both a location and orientation to cast their abilities and properly make on battle tactics aside from the Attack plans.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/5fdbeeefcca08b6a8ee20b6039873bae15c1d98f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/74891b163a98276e53da9ccba93f7048a86819b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes and Report of Crashes on shader compile[/p][p]There is a bug tied to the game engine it self which causes a shader compile crash, if such shader compile crash takes place, try to run the game ither using DirectX 11 execution or Vulkan, which seems to allow the game to run without a crash.[/p][p] [/p][p]Balancing[/p][p]Balance and changes to attacks and enemies damage and life have been adjusted to adjust difficulty as well.[/p][p][/p][p]In the following months I will be updating the Golden version of the game, meaning the full game that will be published when the early access ends, and will be releasing teasing images and videos of them so you can see the adventure that awaits.[/p][p]Stay tuned[/p]

notes.title: LION HOTFIX 3
notes.content:
OK now I have been making several fixes and updates to the game, at the moment new content and bosses are being made, unfortunately those will not be show in the early access, now I have reached a point where most of the content being made will only appear In the final game.
This with exemptions like bug fixes, several abilities and actions being polished with new effects and sounds, and better AI behavior and opsonizations and options, which will be reflected inn the Early access.
The Next Update next week however, will have improvements to the AI of enemies, and will finaly replace the horrible placeholder tank in the red void.
THIS UGLY TANK HAS TO GO AWAY
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/d82b35aaf346fa887ea1af282737a037b26c7d2b.png[/img]

Now for the fixes

[h3]-	New Controls
[/h3]The controls of the game had several changes, primarily when it comes to the Aiming system and Aim Actions, and Special abilities.
The Aim actions have been moved from being execute with the Left bumper or Shift to Holding the Right Trigger or Left Click, this will activate the Aim mode and with the Left Triger and bumper you can call the Shoot attacks, and the Middle mouse button and right mouse button for they board and mouse.
The other are the special abilities.
After introducing the system to change the children’s classes, it came to my attention that the previous system to cast special abilities could no longer be used as it countered with having 5 children of a class, but now the player can have up to 17 children of a same class, so I had to change the system.
The special abilities are called when holding X with controller and Q with keyboard, when pressed the radial menu will be summoned directly into the Special abilities summon section, allowing quick access to them, note that if you execute a Execution or Focus special abilities identified by the EX FO words under them, the radial menu will close, as the Rosamunde can only executes these abelites only one at the time, Casting or CA abilities can be executed without closing the menu. 

[h3]-	Bug fix
[/h3]Among the bug fixes are some related to the controls a and usage of tools sometimes deactivation after activating a tool like the climbing claws

[h3]-	Meshes being replaced
[/h3]Several meshes have been replaced with new ones, for example the, gates of Mechanimoren have been replaced with gates dedicated to that dungeon, the same applies for the elevator, the physical switches and the rotating gears in Mechanimoren and the reactors in the red void.
More meshes are being made to replace several place holders like THE TANK!
Stay tuned.

notes.title: LION The last Home Land 0.4.5
notes.content:
[h1]Great Day To all
[/h1]

First you might have noticed the change on Name, this will represent better the game and its developer now.

NOTE the Old name will still apear in some sections of the game and in the trailers, these will be replaced soon with he new Names
 
Finally, here is the First update of the Year and the one after a long time, I apologize for the big delay in posts and updates, the game has been in serious coding reworks and balancing, having said that the game is still under debugging and many balances and bug fixes are still need it, however the game is ins a state where most of the Game breaking bugs are fixed and is way more balanced now, tutorials have improved and new features are implemented and many are being implemented.
Note that there are still several things that need modifications and big fixes, I will be listing those below
Now to begging with the path Notes

[h2][h1]First a disclaimer: The Tutorial
[/h1][/h2]The tutorial is being reworked since a lot of things changed, so despite having some updated information, stills need several data and challenges changed, this will be implemented in the next Update.

I recommend starting a new game as there were so many changes that your current save file might destroy the balancing of the game.

[h2]Second: Current Detected Bugs
[/h2]-	The grappling hooks 
o	The Grappling hook has several bugs that cause sometimes miss behavior regarding the grapple cable when you stick the cable at physical objects, this will be Fixed in the Next Update
-	Potential issues during the red void and after
o	There might be several Bugs and errors from the red void Onward, these are being rechecked and fixed for the next Update
-	The Graphics and Option Settings
o	There are issues with the Graphic options and several options not saving properly, some users have also reported this, this will be fixed for the next update
-	Him Second Battle
o	Him second battle have several issues that will be also fixed, another is that the Ai will use the same moves as the first fight, that will be changed with new set of attacks for second encounter

[h1]Class Change system
[/h1]The classes of the children can now be changed in the save heavens, this will allow to have more quantities of a certain class of children that the others, previously you were stuck with only 5 children per class, in the case of the early access, 3 per each one, now you could change them to have like 7 reds, 2 yellows, 2 Blues and 1 Green if you wanted to.
This can only be done in the safe heavens only, so you need to prepare this when you are in the safe zones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/4414c64a5dcc2938dc04397af5bc842925c856a2.png[/img]

[h1]Fixes and Changes to Dialogue system
[/h1]The dialogue system had changes under the hood that improved it functionality, also several dialogues have been added to several of the cinematics, the dialogue interface and the whole GUI will have a new Graphic Look in the upcoming Updates

[h1]The Blue Caverns the and the double Jump
[/h1]The double jump is now acquired in a section called the blue caverns, this area triggers an event where you meet Him again and will put you into a test as the carver collapses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/f6d842df5d5586c72392b98e1c0fcc25f6227614.png[/img]

[h1]New cinematics 
[/h1]The Cinematics have been added, and more are coming, the new ones are about meeting Him several time before his first fight, in the upcoming Updates new short sequences will be added for each of the Bosses Deaths
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/4c9246aa9628eb23f4d487617c5c0f05533743e6.png[/img]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
The game has gone a massive balance run, there are still certain attacks, Effects and Enemy attributes that still need adjustment that will be coming in the upcoming patches 

[h1]Synergist Fixes
[/h1]The Synergist Role have several bugs that did not allow the children to properly execute the role well when the children where set in that formation, this had to do mostly with the lack of feedback from effects and sounds and the target set code.
Also, Synergist Now can cause damage to the Enemies Defenses when set on that role, aiding in staggering them and also prevent them from recovering from stager as much as possible.

[h1]Aggro and enemies’ attacks rework
[/h1]The Aggro system has been modified to improve its functionality; healers now will cause big Aggro so make sure to attack with impact children with Rosamunde or set children to tanks to keep attention away from healers and Attackers and Synergists

[h1]New attack plans
[/h1]The attack plans menu had several massive fixes to its menu that cause miss behavior, several adjustments are still being made to improve the UX, also new attack plans were made for the main adventure better adjusted to the progress of the player in the Early access world.

[h1]New Upgrade system
[/h1]The Upgrade system has been drastically changed, it uses the same menu but now you need an specific material for each of the 5 attributes to level them up, these can be found on the world and scale with each level you add to the attribute, for example Raw Power requires 1 Sharp Stone, then at level 1 will require 2 to level up to level 2 and so on, Raw Power increases now by 3 Attack of the children per level.
Speaking of the children upgrades are set now by Squadron class, not per children, making it more accessible and less overwhelming to keep track of 20 Children attributes now only have to track 4 classes attributes, Red Cut.
So when you level up a child the upgrade will be reflected in all the children of the same class.

[h1]New attacks from enemies
[/h1]New enemies are being made but not all are being placed in the Early access due to the Early access world being now complete, I’m currently polishing the world and fixing any bugs there to give the best impression possible of what the final game will look like.
Some enemies however will feature new attacks and abilities.

[h1]Skill Crystals reworked
[/h1]The skill crystals were also reworked, a lot of them had their functionality changed and others are still being tested, keep this in mind.

[h1]The main World
[/h1]Just to remind, what you have been playing is a condensed test world, that will not be present in the final game or if it will be as an unlockable, the main world is way bigger and here I will show it
Also, I recommend starting a new game as there were so many changes that your current save file might destroy the balancing of the game. 

[h1]Enter transition and sectioned zones
[/h1]The game world got exploited for several reasons including performance and ease of development, I determinate making the game complete open world added few to nothing to the world so I sectioned the worlds between transition zones that allow to better optimize the game and take greater control on the system. 
The loading still requires polish and sometimes in rare cases it might crash, I’m currently investigating this

notes.title: Finishing the New Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Great day to all[/b][/h1]
I know it has been a long time since the last update I made, the game has undercome several big changes to its basic code and massive gameplay changes that I could not update the game as I changed something and one big bug appeared out of nowhere, 
I have the intention to update the game this weekend but a nasty bug appeared suddenly and I will seek to updated this next week.

Now to give you an idea of what I have been making here is a preview
The Class Change system
The player will now have the ability to change the class of the children leaving at least one child per class, this will allow the player to customize the number of children for a particular class.
Basically, a green pierce child can be converted to a Yellow Impact child, A Blue Magic Child and a Red Cut child, changing the basic attack that the child uses
This will be available in the early access from eh beginning, however in the final game this will be unlooked further down in the story.

[h2]New Cinematics[/h2]
The new version will include new cinematics that to improve the story telling, some other new ones are being made while I have to polish and remade some others, here for example I added several sequences and an event when obtaining the winged jump 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/f2259d7b84a61526f205e27f5630d11b1f1587c4.png[/img]

[h2]Enemies Recoding[/h2]
The enemies are being recoding to solve massive issues with their AI and functionality, bosses most of all then to get stuck and not perform any actions or disappear from the battle field, most of these issues have been fixed and will come in the next patch.

[h2]Roles and Stances balancing[/h2]
The roles and stances had massive balancing problems and sometimes will not work correctly, especially the Synergist Role, all of these issues have been fixed and will come in the next patch,
First the Sentinel mode, did not properly removed the Passive buff when entering their areas when these got deactivated
Second, the Synergist will not properly get the targets and their attacks did not execute sound effects or sounds, also their effects where quite unbalanced
Now the synergist can cause damage to the defenses of enemies being able to stager them as well
The healers also had problems getting the correct target to heal
Also changed the basic damage of the different attacks of each of the classes and Roles attacks and actions so will be balanced, forcing the player to properly set a good combination of children in proper roles and stances.

[h2]Upgrading system[/h2]
The upgrade system has been simplified, to incentivize exploration, I made the upgrades also tied to key upgrade items like Raw Stones that will be need it to upgrade raw power, each time the player upgrades raw power the base attack will increase by 4, this new material requirements will also apply to the other attributes, however Agility and Intellect are being changed, to unlock certain new Passives and AI actions

[h2]The New Dungeons[/h2]
The final game will have a total 8 dungeons, all of them are currently in production, and I’m laying down their navigation and structure, I’m giving here some look at some of them, I won’t tell the names to not give spoilers, latter down the development I will share more information.

notes.title: LION Update – 0.4.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I know it has been a long time since the last update, it was a busy month for me, however I finishing work in new content the should be ready for the end of this month in June and another for July, as for what has been done to this update…
WELL, IT’S A LOT.
First of all

[h1]Synergist Role[/h1]
A New Whole Role has been added to the game named Synergist, the synergist role is a support type of role where the child that is place in it will be constantly applying buff to the other children, and their Leader Rosamunde, and also will apply debuff to all enemies that does not have the particular debuff that a child class casts.
The type of action it performs is based on their stance, meaning that if they are in aggressive mode, they will perform debuff on enemies.
In Support mod will do Buff on Allies and Rosamunde, and in Sentinel mode to both while also applying another improvement.
Here is a list of the different skills or actions the children will do:
[h2]Cut[/h2]
Enemies - {Bleeding} Bleeding Slice (A low damage attacks that causes bleeding after several hits)
Allies - {Adrenaline} Battle Cry (Increases The Vectors endurance value increasing the Charge while the effect is on **Increases Endurance Attribute**)
[h2]Impact[/h2]
Enemies - {Deprotected} Armor Breaker Smash (Reduces the armor Value of the Target enemy, making them receiving more damage)
Allies - {Guarded} Defensive Drum Smash (Increases the % to perform defensive actions like Evading, Dodging and parry
[h2]Pierce[/h2]
Enemies - {Poisoned} Poison Dart (a poison dart that has high chances of causing poison on enemies)
Allies - {Veil} Repel Wind (protects against debuff decreasing the chances of them landing by half) 
[h2]Magic[/h2]
Enemies - {Slow} Slow Constrains (Decreases the speed of movement attack and action on allies)
Allies - {Haste} Haste Clock (Increases the speed of movement attack and action on allies, Increases Agility Attribute
[h2]SENTINEL Stance Buff
[/h2]Enemies - Cursed Aura (The enemies are Have their Damage received increased and any buff they might have are removed one by one after a time, is good to place long range synergist in sentinel mode so will reduce the defenses of certain enemies)  
Allies - Blessed Aura (It Cures Allies against debuff after being a time on the Area, It also increases the speed at what the children recharge their charge, Note also the medic Role Children can cast Esuna when they detect the child has a debuff applied thus removing the Debuff
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/1f20ef136a6f1346a2eed5924706fb653f783d28.png[/img]

[h1]Sentinel Mode Passive Buff
[/h1]Now the sentinel mode does several things to the child that is in this area guard state, first, it will increase the evasive percent of the skills, Evade, Dodge and Parry, but mostly will add stackable buff based on the role of the child.
For example:
[h2]Attackers Or DPS: 
[/h2]Cast an attack Up Buff, increasing a bit the Attack of the child or base damage, note this effect can be staked and increased fi more Attackers are placed in sentinel mode, and the more children stay inside their bounds the effect will add increasing its power, to the point of being able to cause x2 or x3 the amount of damage the more children stack Attack up from sentinel Attackers zones.
[h2]Defenders or TANKS:
[/h2]The Defenders in sentinel add Damage Reduction to the allies and children inside of the area reducing the damage that the children receive, the more of this effect are staked on top the more damage reduction will receive to the point of reducing damage of attacks from enemies to less than half 
[h2]Healers [/h2]
Healers sentinel areas applies passive healing to all children and Rosamunde when they are inside of the area, making the effect more powerful the more is staked and getting more healed the more children are in Healer Sentinel area close to each other
[h2]Synergists[/h2]:
Synergist apply two different debuff when they are in sentinel mode, the effect applied depends on the target of the child from the sentinel area, if is an enemy, it will apply A debuff that causes the enemy to receive more damage by decreasing the defenses, and if an ally then It Cures Allies against debuff after being a time on the Area, It also increases the speed at what the children recover their charge, allowing to attack more with them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/2a34e24909938f1bd2c498d8ed6db65dc0a8fe59.png[/img]

[h1]New Abilities, but not accessible yet 
[/h1]Several new abilities have been made, however I have not place them jet on the early aces world to get them in the game, at the moment I’m considering review all the abilities placed and change their location and witch ones are obtained as I have to start populating the main world of the final game with such upgrades.
These new abilities being made are to give more variety on special abilities for the different roles for the different child classes.
Among the new abilities that are being made are: 
[b[u]][i]Green Pierce Ability[/i][/u]
[b]Decoy (Defender)
Ricochet Dart (Defender)
Guard Turret (Healer)
Healing Bombs (Healer)[/b]
[u][i]Blue Magic Ability[/i][/u]

Force Field (Defender)
Astral Canon (Attacker)[/b]
[i][u]Yellow Impact Ability[/u][/i]

Lightning Chain (Attacker)
Close Circuit (Healer)
Ground Cover (Synergist)[/b]
[i][u]Red Cut Ability[/u][/i]

Sword Dance (Defender)
Slash Storm (Attacker)
Stars Disks (Healer)[/b]

[h1]A Lot of the previous abilities have been implemented, 
[/h1]New 3D Models have been added to them and also new animations and functionality, for example the sub machine gun now has a model and animation what will spawn a sub machine gun with a reticule indicating the ammo left, and there are many new abilities like this.
Now also several abilities have unique 3D Models that will appear on the back of the children representing third equipped gear or ability like the seeker missiles of the green pierce children, will make appear a massive missile launcher on the back of the child.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/fb81a03c88beae2c97b60ce4fb074e1c586d3072.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Attack Plans Editor[/h1]
The attack plans editor has been massively improved, the attack plan manager is the same for now, but the editor has received an overhaul, now it spawns a 3d space to better see the position of the children and new icons and selectors have ben put in place to better se the children positions and stances and actions.
This is the New One.
Quite an improvement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/a165227e203fc3c8a56fd4ce923e476f6610df5c.png[/img]


[h1]Tutorial level Extension[/h1]
The tutorial level has also been expanded, now there is a new section right on the first section of the game, after obtaining the double jump there is new path the takes deep into the forest, and better explain the combat system, Roles, stances and commands alongside the child launch and canon.

Among the new enemies are the:
[b]Elementers

[h1]Tools Improvement and Combat implementation [/h1]

The Tools the player uses to platform and traverse the world ca now be also used for combat, the climbing claws will grab enemies, the levitation will lift enemies that have no defensed.
However, the grappling hook and the mostly the rocket booster received the most drastic improvement.

The grapple hook can be used in two ways, if you tap the button of the tool, you will pull any enemy you hook to at you, pulling enemies in difficult of reaching areas or airborne enemies.

If you Hold the grapple hook button then you will perform a homing like attack at the target and bounce on them once you reach them, allowing to use enemies as platform.

The Rocket boosters on the other hand, has a new whole upgrade that allows to fly on static charged areas, this is done by simply suing the rocket booster on those sections.

As for combat the booster can cause a stun and knockback on the impact area useful to instantly tun several enemies.

Now the children can be commanded to use the tool in the attack plans and also im implementing the command to be called form the Radial menu and Management Battle Menu

The radial menu has received new improvement and also the presentation has been changed, this for clearer information, and ease of access, still there are some actions that need to be implemented that will be implemented for a hotfix as there are being cause by a bug that I’m investigating, this is mostly for the Special Actions submenu.
As for PC if you are using a keyboard and mouse only, I made a radial menu called management Battle Menu that uses only the mouse and a few keys of the keyboard to quickly command children in slow motion but with proper PC control

The Main World of the Game in Production 
The main world of the game is now being made, at the moment the entire world is on the block out state and I’m placing where the upgrades are going to be obtained, at the moment some areas are blocked out, some have the base terrain and many of the dungeons are in blocking out state.

notes.title: LION Update 0.4.08
notes.content:
Great Saturday to all.
In this new set of patches, I have been making, I have fixed several bugs with the game and making adjustments, there is still some key features that are missing and witch I will be developing during the year.

-The action arrow indicator has several fixes and resized;
-The number of materials given by enemies has been adjusted.
-The pierce and Magic children have better aiming and positioning when aiming from low and high places.
-The respawn in Mechanimoren will not suddenly transport you to another room
-The HUD had several size and changes where text indicates the mechanics of several input buttons.
-The radial menu now shows the attack plans position of the children and witch ones will go to execute it.
-The radial menu also has now changed the execution of actions, that is now divided into Assault and Aid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/e906f1d311307734851122fb4d607d0964df9584.png[/img]

notes.title: August Dev Log - LION UPDATE 0.4!! OUT!!
notes.content:
Good day everyone and happy September hope this burning summer ends soon. 
To celebrate I’m finally manage to have the core features of LION ready for the Update 0.4, there is a Buch of adjustments and bug fixes I must make to the game as is not completely cheeked, but I decided it was time you get to see what I have been cooking for the game for half a year.

However, lots of what you are going to see at plain sight won’t be so different, and there are several reasons for it, I have not made more models, or animations that I wanted to because I spent several months rewriting the core code of the game. This was necessary to ensure I could continue on expanding the gameplay and options latter down the line, as it was quite badly written.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/81626e264b5e77992faf2d61095ee2317fe889d3.png[/img]
This allowed me to implement key mechanics that you will get to test inside the game, which are.
-	The New Radial menu
-	The Special Abilities 
-	The Attack Plans
-	The Physical Systems
-	The Roles and Stances 
-	New Controls System
-	Leveling Up and materials 
-	RPG attributes
-	Rewritten Grab Objects system.

Before explaining this new feature to those how haven’t read the previous logs, I’m letting you know that I will be making several updates during the Month, this for several reasons, the game will be feature for the Latinx Games Fest this September 15, I which you got the time to see the events and support the projects and games that will be talked about in it including mine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/11c1a35754bd351069081345f47d2d0538793592.jpg[/img]

Also, I’m realizing this update a bit early that I was preparing some bugs will appear and some things might be mistranslated or unfinished. I will be making like crazy lots of bug fixes and 3D Models and Animations, to include new attacks for enemies and Bosses, and have several mechanism-like objects being carried y children with proper final 3D models as well as other interactable, and including new graphics for example the loading screen which will look pixelated for now. After that the next months I will be working in a tutorial level for the demo and early access and new sections on the early access world to extent the gameplay and conclude the early access world to focus mainly in the main world of the game in which I spent some time but I cannot afford to show anything at the moment.
So let me explain each new mechanic.

[h1][b]-	The New Radial menu
[/b][/h1]The Radial Menu received a massive overhaul, the items or children that appear on the menu show more data than before and allows to change certain stances and roles witch I will explain ahead in the menu itself. Also now includes other 3 sub menus to select and execute attack plans, Special Abilities and also to select Objects being carried. 
For the children a main capsule colored behind them represents their role, DPS, Tank, healer, and another under which resents their stance, that determinates their Target seeker behavior.
Also appears above them Target they are attacking and the amount attacking the child with red dots around their portrait. 

Inside the menu the player can select and command children while the time slows downs to allow a tactical and pause view of the action allowing to make complex decisions in the heat of battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/affe563af8a798a711bfd23eac23af2e13021822.png[/img]


[h1][b]-	The Special Abilities 
[/b][/h1]The special abilities are massive attacks and special attacks or actions that can be equipped to each child, but only 1 per each of them, these abilities can cast powerful attacks at the cost of some of the charge of the child executing it, and also will require a cooldown equivalent to the power of the ability. 
These abilities can be called by the children themselves outside of formation at any given moment when they seem necessary.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/10077a0c965404fb36aae94df09c2af15d122888.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	The Attack Plans
[/b][/h1]The attack plans are a big system I made to allow the players to fast and efficiently command children in the heat of battle, this by obtaining and creating a set of premade commands of movement followed by a stance and role assigned to them.
These plans can for example set all blue and green children as healers and set them on the back relative to Rosamunde orientation to heal all children and Rosamunde that will stand right in front of them, or another to send tanks forward and cast their abilities upon reaching their location of movement to draw full ago and cause massive damage.
These Plans can be obtained on the world and also can be completely custom made in a menu inside of the Inventory menu at the right bottom section
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/da459e720319f55a95aa4d03b5a858e6978d46a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/b7228226d317bc4f48e72c2b812a1f32e5a0da2c.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	The Roles and Stances 
[/b][/h1]This is an extremely important system for the RTS combat and control, the roles and stances.
The Roles are the class trinity seen in many RPGs and MMORPGs, Tank, Healer and DPS, each child of each color has access to each of the 3 roles or Jobs, allowing to Focus on protection, Damage or Healing, this can be changed at run time ither using attack plans or the radial menu by pressing RT. Also, their stance is a Stance or position regarding enemies, it focuses on how the child will seek targets or if to seek them at all, there are 4 stances, Aggressive, Sentinel, Passive and Supporter.
Aggressive will seek any target closes by or that matches some criteria based on the role. 
Sentinel will spawn a Circle area that will set the child guard area and the child will not heal nor attack anyone that is outside of this circle, this circle range varies according to the child type or color.
Passive will do its command and upon completing it will remain in wait or idle and will do nothing not matter what until commanded otherwise
Supporter will seek all lied children and Rosamunde and check if require aid form the current class the child has, for instance a tank in support mode will check if Rosamunde is being attacked and will seek to Aggro the enemies away to the tank, healers will check her health and heal her if necessary and DPS will attack any targets that Rosamunde or any other child might be attacking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/488ac1048bb7e528dd25ae2d492b71836c6423d6.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	New Controls System
[/b][/h1]The Controls have received some drastic changes, the main one is that commanding and selecting are done with the Left Triggers now, more specifically Commanding is done with LT and The Special Commands like Shoot and launch are done Holding LT like before, Selecting is done by taping LB and Aiming with Holding LB, the Tools like the Climbing Claws and Grapple Hook, boosters and levitation are done with RB, also the call back have been changed to a constant call area with
 
[h1][b]-	The Physical Systems
[/b][/h1]The Physical system are a set of 3 system that combines Weight, Temperature and Electrical charge on certain objects and witch the children and certain elemental objects can influence, for example the Impact Children can obtain in the Final Game the Thunder medal that allows to cast electrical powers and can charge temporally certain mechanical objects, however the charge can be altered by temperature and increase the weight of an object requiring more children to lift, being magic children able to cool down an object using ice magic.
At the moment I’m creating an extension on the early access in the red void area that will implement a puzzle using this system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/f6a075f204644abbfec3c17b2848d17a6b1c09e1.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	Leveling Up and materials 
[/b][/h1]Now you can level up the each of the children and increasing their 5 core attributes based on their armor parts being, their weapons Raw Power, Their Agility Scarf, their Book of Intellect, their Armor Constitution and Body Vectors Endurance, which increases their Base damage, Defenses, Awareness and Critical Hit, total Max Life Units and Total Charge.
These children can be leveled up by the Atlantios NPCs that are in most heavens save stations, this is done using 5 materials types collected from enemies. Each child must be increase individually and can be customized to fit your play stile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/3cfde1ab703e06820a74b21eea01235ec15e0448.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/5c0498eb484f7c8e94bb58310e768f5c6bdf2f79.png[/img]

[h1][b]Rewritten Grab Objects system and Massive Bug Hunt down [/b][/h1]
The grab object system used to Carry objects has been rewritten and remade and working better than before, also a massive Bug hut was made to being able to further extent the game with having bugs in the inner code protentional causing massive issues down the line. The amount was so big that I cannot enumerate them all, but many more will be fixed like one you will encounter with the ability Thunder ball that does not collide properly, I’m currently checking that ability to fix it. That and many other things will be fixed in the several patches I will be making in this month of September, stain tuned to check the new features of the game and new content coming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/f707f4dd3f8716293be10f181017e0b6d280824c.png[/img]

notes.content:
Great day everyone, these have been quite busy two months in which i have been working on the game, after receiving the award from Latinx in gaming, now My Game LION is set to also appear in a Stream and Conversion from the Latinx Games Fest, that takes place in September.
They will be talking about my game and playing them, this will be really exiting to see the reactions and feedback they can give.

These paths two months, has been mostly Polishing of the game and improving the AI of the Enemies and Children also creating the New Attack Plan System.

[h1][b]The New Update for LION after so many moths will come this month[/b][/h1]
I cannot precise a date but probably for around the 15 of August will be realized, I will let know the week or the day before I do so.
NOTE that this is the first of 5 updates that will be released each moth until the year ends, as will complete the core mechanics and section of the early access world and the game demo, all the rest that will be developed Next year will be the core content of new enemies, Worlds and Main story and bosses.

[h1][b]The Attack Plan System and New AI[/b][/h1]
The attack plan System is finally done and alongside it its Editor, inside of the game you will find default made attack plans if you don’t want to spend time creating your own, however the system will be also there for when you want to customize the ones you obtain or create your own from 0.

The first 4 attack plans can be called by Holding LT and Pressing one of the DPad buttons to call up to 4 attack plan systems, the other 4 are called from the radial menu. 

Also the attack plan system of the children has been drastically improved, there is still adjustments to make, but now the children can dodge, evade and even parry incoming attacks, also can change their position when they have no sight of their target and can execute their special attacks by themselves when they deem it necessary. 

[previewyoutube=LVuES58N7MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Massive Bug Fixing and New Child Canon and Launch[/b][/h1]
A lot of time was spent in fixing bugs in the game, there were many system that got broken after I remade some Core Code of the game and some systems, now everything is working properly, also the Attacks Like the Child Launch and the Stick on Enemies mechanics is working even better as well as using the Child Canon, which now Has New Mechanics, not only is fixed when the children are launched at grab object so they will pick them up but also will perform unique effects and attacks on enemies when thy hit them.

[h1][b]Radial menu New Modes[/b][/h1]
The radial menu, now includes 4 sections that are changed with the Dpad or Numbers 1234, these will change to the Attack Plans, Special Abilities, and objects being Grabbed or Interacted to by children. Allowing to manage and call actions from them in the middle of the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/398de3b412f7d1353aee73bcff639ec8b8b212ee.png[/img]

[h1][b]Enemies Ranks[/b][/h1]
Enemies now posses something called a rank system, is like a small replacement for levels, this ranks systems has 6 levels, and will increase the enemies’ attributes and also their appearances well as granting them new abilities and attacks.
Here is an example of this with the Uro Magi and the Orphans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/6e4f86c682a171bec6fd4046f7de5b2b31c92de5.png[/img]

[h1][b]The Upgrade System[/b][/h1]
The upgrade system also got several changes, is still based on obtained materials but now the expense on them is based on level and not individual attribute.
The max level each attribute can have been yet to be determinate as I’m considering to see if I should allow the player reach or set the children up to level 50 or level 100, meaning that each of the 5 attributes could be at max level 10 placing equal amount of level up in each attribute to reach 50 or max 25 if it is 100.

[h1][b]Remaking of The Dialogue System[/b][/h1]
The dialogue system core code was completely changed, it had quite a lot of limitations, this new system will ensure ease of use and better execution of the dialogues and evens and will allow to properly set up dialogues for cinematics and events.

New Abilities and The Child Canon and Grabbing Skills 
New Abilities were programed for the children and will be available in the Update of September, also the AS told before, the Child Canon and Child launch now have unique effects.


AS show the children perform unique attacks based on their type, red children will perform acrobatic grab and Smash attack on enemies, yellow children will do massive hit that will send enemies flying backwards, green children perform a shoot that won’t stop until reaching its destination and will knockback enemies to the sides

A lot of these moths went digging under the Dirt and Fixing the Pile of... CRAP CODE I made at the beginning, thus Making sure you get the least number of bugs while playing, you will notice the elements of the game with improved performance and more snaping in response.

notes.title: Game Progress New Features and Scope of new Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, first of all, the game is receiving huge changes to its systems and even I had to reprogram some of them to make them function better, thus the update that I wanted to post this month is moved, this time I won’t give a specific date, as I don’t want to disappoint you, my objective is to see if I can have it ready for the end of May but is not a guaranty. 

I apologies for those who wanted the game updated sooner, but remember the game is in active development and sometimes, these types of headaches happen when to improve or extend something that needs to be reworked and is what is happening to me right now. This is the reason for the delay, I want to make sure the upgrade is substantial and not small.

I thank you all that have purchased the early access, not only the money you have contributed but also that has given me strength knowing there are people that trusts me and has faith in me and my videogame, and thank you all and I won’t disappoint you.
Now for the things I have been doing this month…


[b]-First of all, THE HUD
[/b]it has been completely changed to a simpler easy to understand with better information HUD. The HUD now shows a straight line with all children organized from left to right in their formation order and squadron position, and condition, being 1 to 5 from left to right, you can also change now the position of the children inside their squadron’s formation using the new menu in the inventory section, just need to press on any of the children and go to the position option, then you will get inside the Positions Options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/9310d03c397c4688d2feabce65e3a653f534878a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/9de1e46bb0dee6794306f3e24bb6f3d587e13ab4.png[/img]

[b]-Positions Configurator
[/b]The positions of the children will now be key, each child can now be independently be upgraded meaning that sometimes you will have stronger children than others in the same squadrons, when you attack by default, you will use the first children in the first positions in the squadrons, this allows you to change that order and switch children positions.
This is also key for the special abilities that I’m making, each special ability as show here is mapped to a button and the position of the child in the squadron determinates witch button is required to execute its special ability.
[previewyoutube=9TdikakV2AM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]-Special Abilities
[/b]These are unique powers that each child can equip when in heavens, there are different from skill crystals, while skill crystals are Items or items to equip for all children or  an specific squadron, the special abilities are given a single child and these are based on the class of the child so only Cut red children can equip Cut Class abilities, these are things like the previous charge attack that is moved to an especial ability, and the crystal attack as well, but new ones like a healing area sone for magic children, these cost a Signiant amount of charge and will have a cooldown before being able to use again.

[b]-Change to the skill crystals
[/b]Several of the skill crystals have become obsolete, ither because some abilities are useless, moved to abilities or directly implemented into the game by default like the parry system and doge of the children against incoming attacks.
The list of changes to these skill crystals will be listed in the patch notes when the next game patch is out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/f8bb1aeff6801b0b6b17057eaadc7bc4bc1ca1f7.png[/img]

[b]-GUI and Interface finally fixed
[/b]You might have noticed a problem with LION´s Interface, especially when using the gamepad, that it loses Focus, meaning none of the buttons can be pressed and then you will need to use the mouse to selected them, this is finally fixed for good. The transition from keyboard to mouse is better now.

[b]-New combat mechanics
[/b]The combat system of LION also received severe modifications, aside from the Ability systems, the new combat integrates the parry technique on all attacks by default, this means the parry will execute a different type of parry and deflection depending on the attack or Damage type, now each child causes a different type of damage type going from Cutting, Impacting, Piercing, and Magical… Yes, is based on their classes. But also Wave Damage has been added alongside elemental bonuses.
These damage types cause a different parry when you use an attack that intercepts with another’s enemy attack, cut damage causes a standard parry stopping the damage of both attacks, if impact damage intercepts the enemy, it will be deflected, stopping the attack and breaking its stance leaving vulnerable, pierce wills top the movement of the enemy attacker at your direction and will reduce the damage of its attack, and magic will slow it down significant and rotate it into a random direction. 
You can also deflect projectiles and the effects will vary depending on the child used to intercept the bullet.
[previewyoutube=vjzu3aHWcW0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]-New grab object system
[/b]The system to grab objects as also been modified and works way better now, executing the abilities like the frost shoot or lacer is way easier this time, you just need to call the action command by holding the command button LB while selecting the object and then press the right trigger button.
Add it with this is the Physical system that I talked about before is now implemented, certain objects might need to be charged to be even lifted and some triggers and switches require charge to be switched on like it happens in Mechanimoren sometimes, now you will see a floating indicator on top of those switches saying they have no charge and need an object that can charge them up to activate them again.
[previewyoutube=WujpACh1_ZE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]-Materials and Upgrade system + Balancing of enemies using Ability systems 
[/b]Now to upgrade the children you need to obtain a new type of collectable, materials, and you might know them as the crystals enemies let loosed when you defeat them, now are replaced with 5 different types of materials spawned depending on the amount of damage and type of damage they receive, these materials are Wood, Metal, Crystal, Circuits and Stone, these are sued to upgrade one or several of the 5 attributes or stats of each child.
Raw Power – Responsible for base damage
Intelligence – responsible for Abilities Duration, and better performance of the children
Agility – Speed of actions 
Constitution – Responsible for the base Life value
Endurance – Responsible for the Base Charge Value and recharge speed
Agility and Intelligence are a bit special is that at certain levels will unlock or add up to specific skills or attributes when reached, I did not want to many stats considering that you have to level up to 20 children so I have to condense all to only 5 stats.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250067/28dc30ede6a8d70a84005b44fc9cf46729f0b6e1.png[/img]

[b]-Massive Bug fixing and performance bosting
[/b]Also the performance of the game has been improved decreasing some of the requirements of the game for PC, ill keep working hard to increase the performance of the game even more.

AS you can see so many changes were made and are being made, so much so that the project basically broke and I had to restructure using the new systems, also I’m seeking to extend a bit the early access world with 3 new Challenges, or before accessing the Great tower and fighting the Atlantios, and other 2s after entering Mechanimoren.
also, I’m preparing to make smaller cinematics where HIM is shown before massing things up, so has a better build up before its boss fight.
And talking about enemies, the new systems now require all enemies to be tweaked, and their attacks adjusted. I want to make a Clear difference from the previous version to the initial posted one when the game was out so you can see who much you have given me strength to keep this game going.

Also, a known not all of you will be reading this but a clear sing of when the new update is live is that all graphic material in the store and the cover art will eb replaced with new ones.

notes.title: RADICAL CHANGES - The Upcoming Update Features
notes.content:
Great day to all, the new update to LION is coming at the end of this month and is filed with some of the last Game Core feature LIONS will have to grant a unique gameplay experience. lots of features will be realized by the end of this months and many gameplay changes and improvements that will enhance the gameplay experience.

I decided to focus on polishing the code and make quite some drastic changes to the code so the game performs better, new graphical content and replacement for many place holders will be made in the following moths, right now I’m finishing my work in these features I’m describing below, witch ill hopefully be ready for the for the update of February at the end of the moth.

Radial Menu
One of the new core features that first has been hugely improved I s the radial menu, this mechanic was already implemented but need it a lot of improvement, which I managed to implement, first of all the radial menu slows down the game and allowing you to use a comfortable radial menu selection to command the children.
From it you can Select, Unselect, send to attack or move, send back and order them to use special abilities, this menu Will also allow you to move the camera while in the menu so you can see what’s is going on, this is especially useful on top down or tactical mode where you can see a full view of your surroundings.

[previewyoutube=2V4W1cRuoQ0;full][/previewyoutube]

Upgrade System 
The Upgrade system is a new system implemented to level Up the children you command, you do this by talking with specific NPCs, for now I’m suing the default NPC the Atlantiros guide to allow level up by speaking with them and selecting, upgrade Children´s Gear in the dialogue options.
When chosen a Menu will appear allowing to select a child and upgrade the 5 core attributes. 
Raw Power – the increases the base Attack Damage
Agility – Increase speed of casting, attack and movement also increases the skill of blocking or dogging more attacks.
Intellect – Increases the Duration of effects, and Buff caused by the children and reduces dubuff duration casted on them
Constitution – Increases the Resistance of the children against knockback and reduces the damage received by enemies
Endurance – increases the Recharge speed of their charge and also in several level thresholds it will increase their total Charge which is their stamina. 

Material Collection
To increase the level, you need to collect materials, these are obtained from defeating enemies and extracting them from several extraction points, each child poses a unique damage type that will cause the extraction of materials from enemies depending if the enemy possess that damage.
For instance, cut children can use their damage type, cutting to extract wood from enemies that have wood parts on them.
The materials are 
Wood, Metal, Stone, Crystal, And Circuits these are used to increase one and latter all stats to level up each child.

New Grab system
The grab system to carry and lift objects with eh children has also been reworked, for better controls and behavior, this will also allow to grab certain enemies and parts of bigger enemies to stun them for several seconds.
Also, you can now use the radial menu to control the objects being carried by the children, making it easy to manage your squadrons.

Support actions
The combat system also received several tweaks, first of all each child type or squadron type has an unique Role, Cut children and Pierce children the red and greens are DPS troops, the Yellow or impact children are Tanks and the Magic ones or Blue are healers, take this in consideration when choosing support actions, when a child is selected and the command button is sent on another child, the kid will perform a support action, in blue children is simple as will heal the target, in DPS and Tank kids will attack the target of the kid or the enemies that are attacking the kids, this is to know better what child will most likely doing each time.

Also, the skill crystal Parry Attack Deflection and Healer squadron will have several changes, this is because by default the player can Now parry attacks by intercepting the attack with another of your own, and depending on the attack you can Counter them or simple deviate or defect the attack depending on the damage type.
The skill crystal Attack deflection now will enhance and modify slightly this, this also means that the Crystal shield is eliminated and replaced with a healing skill that will consume an entire child charge to heal close by children only, aiding with the healing process.

Special Moves
And last but definitely not leas the special abilities, these are triggered by holding the attack button, as will no longer execute a charge attack but launch an especial technique or ability and among them are the regular charge attacks plus many other new combat skills, and role skills.
These are equipped in the inventory menu and child can only carry on and use one ither in formation or in combat, when the Attack button or RT is hold, the player needs to press one of 5 buttons, in the gamepad are A, B, Y, X and LB, so the player can have a total of 20 abilities once all children are obtained and can duplicate them even so multiple children like for example the blue ones can have 2 different version of a powerful Stardust technique that rains projectiles on enemies. 

These are the core elements that most likely will appear on the next update at the end of this month, this Upgrade is planed for realize in the last week of February or in March 4 on Saturday the latest, ill do my best to give you this new feature soon enough.
The next month will have Improved enemy AI and New Enemies and In April new sections and challenges for the Early access world and a new Level for the Demo for beginners and new 3d Models for new environments as well as New NPCs, the Blacksmith and… a new Foe… or Ally?...
See you soon a stay tuned. When the patch comes ill repeat and extent this information to confirm what made it out for the Upgrade.
